summary: Gyomu Concept is a python package responsible for generating structured project documentation—such as README files and LLM contexts—through modular document definitions, section builders, and underlying package and directory concept analyses.
responsibilities: Orchestrate the generation and translation of structured project documentation like READMEs and LLM contexts.
Define and configure document sections, output renderers, and file path resolvers.
Process, analyze, and manage hierarchical package and directory concepts.

capabilities.name: Document Generation and Rendering
capabilities.description: Manages structured document generation, rendering, translation, and context initialization for creating project documentation.

capabilities.name: LLM Context Composition
capabilities.description: Composes specialized sections—such as architecture, design principles, and guidelines—for constructing LLM contexts.

capabilities.name: Directory Concept Management
capabilities.description: Builds, loads, processes, and persists hierarchical directory concepts and file summary records.

capabilities.name: Package Concept Operations
capabilities.description: Handles package-level concepts, dependency collection, path resolution, and persistence operations.

design_decisions: Modular section-based building architecture separates content definition from rendering and formatting.
Asynchronous document and section building supports efficient generation workflows.
Explicit context initialization loads necessary package knowledge files prior to building documents.
usage_guidance: Use the document generation modules to initialize contexts and build rendered documents based on defined templates and translations.
Leverage section builders and LLM context tools to assemble structured prompts or context files for AI tooling.
Utilize package and directory concept utilities to analyze, load, and save architectural metadata.
